notes.title: The Dead Format Demo is out now!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, [/p][p][/p][p]I am happy to announce the release of the Dead Format demo, which is live on Steam today! [/p][p][/p][p]Dead Format is a mixed-media game featuring live footage recorded with homemade practical effects! You will be using tapes that contain this footage to dive into cinematic eras of film. In this demo, you can explore the gothic horrors of the 1930s and the industrial sci-fi scenes of 1980s body horror.[/p][p][/p][p]This has been a cumulation of hard work over the past couple of months, I hope you enjoy your time playing. In celebration of this new demo, here is a brand new trailer![/p][previewyoutube="MxLFopZii2k;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Play the Dead Format Demo[/b][/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399290/Dead_Format/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Search for supplies to stay alive and uncover key items to solve puzzles, unlocking your path forward.[/p][/*][*][p]Arm yourself with weapons and tools inspired by the film worlds you’ll explore.[/p][/*][*][p]Discover eerie VHS footage that blurs the line between fiction and reality.[/p][/*][*][p]Your apartment is the only place you can save the game. Find shortcuts and new paths to progress on your journey.[/p][/*][*][p]Each world comes with its own enemies, puzzles, and unique art style.[/p][/*][*][p]Something lurks in the shadows, tracing your every step.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please feel free to leave your thoughts in the Steam forums of your playthrough! Take care and see you next time.[/p]

notes.title: Dead Format news - Demo coming soon!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It's been a while. Dead Format has been progressing well since the reveal. The Steam page has now been updated with new screenshots, new gifs, and even a new VHS trailer![/p][p][/p][p]The demo is coming soon, this will be the first time a playable version of the first level will be made public, so feedback and thoughts will be very welcome! [/p][p][/p][p]Perhaps that's enough text, and now it's time to show the game itself?[/p][p][/p][h3]The Apartment [/h3][p][/p][p]Welcome to the "hub area" of Dead Format, where you can watch video tapes and catch your breath. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/b33fb76e9cfffbc2a4594f385acbca6465070e85.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/9704af033e7067e7dcdc9a2b156168acf91c057c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]VHS Tapes[/h3][p][/p][p]These illegal VHS tapes were banned for a reason. Upon viewing, you will be transported to different film eras, each providing new clues as to where your brother might be. [/p][p]The first universe to explore is the Silent Era. Thick fog weighs heavily on your shoulders as thunderstorms ripple through the sky. Make your way through catacombs, with every step revealing new mysteries and events that were best left to be forgotten.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/ccf1d94bb8babf99f91b8c3502f483ebc99a0a75.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/b87db51e84ec95491fadb1730304a9661ff82159.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What's in the demo?[/h3][p][/p][p]Exploring the worlds follows the classic survival horror formula where new paths are unlocked after major discoveries. Players then return to the hub with their new learnings and can push on through different paths.[/p][p]To avoid too many spoilers, you will be travelling in the Silent Era universe described above. Here's a sneak peek![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/bbadafe1968a56c7f0e9675c6d3276f09145f841.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577192/5ec169e59faa79b7f051f701f50ff85c1ba83e49.png"][/img][/p][p]Thanks for reading and talk again very soon! [/p]
